tools.name: check_car_availability
tools.description: Lists the rental cars that are free in North Cyprus (Kıbrıs araç kiralama) for a pickup and return time, each with its photo, its full price and a link that opens the booking form on that car. With a pickup place, return place or add-ons, total_eur includes them.

tools.name: list_prices
tools.description: The North Cyprus car rental price list (Kıbrıs araç kiralama fiyatları), without dates: daily rates per car class and rental length, add-on prices and one-time pickup or return fees, with insurance and VAT included. With a currency, amounts are also given in it as *_quoted.

tools.name: next_available
tools.description: Finds the soonest time a rental car in North Cyprus is free for a given number of days. Requires duration_days. Without an earliest pickup the search starts from now, and the result gives that start as searched_from.

tools.name: company_info
tools.description: Company information written by Kipra Rent A Car staff, in English: location, hours, delivery places, rental terms, insurance, deposit, driver age and licence, payment and crossing the border.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Returns a link to the North Cyprus car booking page with the dates filled in. The person picks a car and confirms there. No credit card or deposit is needed.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Files a car rental request in North Cyprus for a person who has agreed to the car, dates, places, extras and total, using their own name, email and phone. tools.name: get_fx_rates
tools.description: The current EUR-based TRY, USD and GBP exchange rates used by the booking engine.
